title: Hatsune Miku — Feeling Down, Down, Down〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank goodness Rui feels a little better now♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I really appreciate how you always listen to our concerns.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll try giving it some more thought and see which way I should go...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope Rui goes back to smiling soon...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? There's something on the ground over there...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Ohh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
B-Birdie?!
Did you fall over again?!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
Oof... Thanks, Miku.
I really appreciate you helping me again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's okay♪
I mean, we're friends, right? And fellow show performers☆

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I'm sorry for asking so much of you guys...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
Flying freely through the sky...
Putting on a show that makes it look fun and exciting... Showing you all how amazing it feels...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: That's what I've always wanted to do... That's why I wanted to do a show on top of the flying train.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But your show was so good! I really liked it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You did a great job of showing us just how fun it is to fly in the air! A really, really great job!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks, Miku.
I'm glad I got to do my show too.

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Still... I couldn't help but feel kinda sad while I was walking over here...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I keep wondering if it would've been more fun if you guys did that show with me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Birdie...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Actually, Birdie!
There's something I want to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Tell me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I waited until now because I didn't want to bother you while you were so focused on practicing...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Wow! You guys came up with all these ideas for my show?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! Rin, Len, KAITO, MEIKO and Luka all helped♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We did our best to get as close as possible to the original idea for your show...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But based on your performance, I understand now that the show you wanted to do is what we just saw... That's what we have to do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is why we were so impressed with how you followed through with it until the very end!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Um, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I wanna do a show with you guys. One with flying and everything.

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I wanna do the show you guys came up with!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?! Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: It's true that your ideas are a little different from what I wanted to do.

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: But seeing the ideas you came up with made me want to try them out!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You do?! Yay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, there you are!
Hey, we found Miku and Birdie!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness... We were getting worried since we hadn't seen you all day.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh no! I'm so sorry!
I was busy looking for Birdie and talking to Rui.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that explains quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
More importantly! Everyone!
Birdie said we should do that show we all came up with!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah! Wh-What do you guys think...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We definitely want to! Right, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
Woohoo♪
Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's head back to the stage and tell Luka the good news!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah! Birdie, let's go♪
I'll carry you on my shoulders☆

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks!
